description: Tovolo Silicone Tools, Spatula, Spoonula and Turner

Tovolo has designed this Set of 3 colorful kitchen tools with the everyday cook in mind while livening up your cooking experience. A spatula, spoonula, and turner give you a taste of our essential cooking tools.

Tovolo's silicone spatula is the perfect kitchen tool for mixing, folding, serving, spreading, scraping and flipping. This tool will hold to the toughest cook. The Spoonula is a versatile tool great for mixing, scooping, and serving. The turner is great for scraping, flipping, turning; a great tool for stir fry. The Tovolo Set of 3 Kitchen Tools are durable, lightweight, and easy to use.
Each nylon handle delivers the perfect weight and balance in your hand while providing an easy grip. From head to handle's end the spatula measures 12.5"Lx2.4"Wx.4"H

The silicone head is flawless. Edges are tapered to a sharp point to scrape the side of the bowl completely clean. The square corner will fit into the tightest spots of any pan and the completely smooth surface allows for even spreading. The spatula head is heat resistant up to 600degree F. The bright colors will not fade, chip, peel, or tear. Silicone is great for nonstick cookware and bakeware and will not scratch the surface.
